        About this item

        • 🌙 Ultimate Side-Sleeper Comfort: Engineered with an ultra-compact, low-profile design that sits flush in your ear—perfect for side sleepers to enjoy a pain-free, restful night.
        • ☁️ Skin-Friendly Soft Silicone: Crafted from premium, velvet-soft silicone that offers a lightweight, pressure-free fit, making you feel like you aren't wearing earphones at all.
        • 🎵 Balanced 13mm Audio: Powered by 13mm Drivers tuned specifically for sleep, delivering crisp and soothing sound for white noise, relaxing podcasts, or deep-sleep melodies.
        • 🔇 Noise-Reducing Seal: The ergonomic in-ear fit acts as a natural shield, blocking out disruptive ambient sounds like snoring or city traffic for a distraction-free slumber.
        • 🐍 Durable Sleep-Proof Cable: Features a high-quality, tangle-resistant TPE wire that is flexible enough to handle nightly tossing and turning without snapping or tangling.

          Customers say

          Customers praise these earphones for their sound quality, with one noting crystal-clear audio, and appreciate their build quality with good wire construction. The earphones are comfortable for side sleepers, allowing extended listening without pain, and fit snugly while staying in place. While the material feels soft, reliability receives mixed feedback, with some customers reporting that the earphones stopped working.

          • Aanshu Aanshu
            5 out of 5 stars
            No deal breaking aspects, and good product.
            Reviewed in India on 9 May 2026
            Colour: Black
            Verified Purchase
            Brief content visible, double tap to read full content.
            Full content visible, double tap to read brief content.

            The build quality is good, idk what the other reviewers are facing.

            Portability is better than a any wireless ones as it isn't as heavy or bulky, you're more likely to forget they were in your pocket.

            Works with laptops and my poco phone thinks it's a xiaomi wired earphone, so I got access to their xiaomi sound stuff, neat!

            Looks nice too.

            And the sleep thing is true as you won't feel it outside your ear.

            It goes just slightly more deeper than other earphones, so there is some getting used to it.

            Because it did give me a headache the first day.

            The mic is good, almost close to phone inbuilt mics. So I like it for calls.

            Okay now to the things I would love to see changed atleast in the next generation of this:

            I like the braided cable part of it but the 2 wires that split for the earphones themselves are rubber and had too much grip so it feels sticky.

            What I don't like is how every little vibration or touch on the cable is directly transmitted to my ear.

            Every time to cable shakes or moves I can hear all the things that the earphone is feeling, I hate that. I can hear my own heartbeat through it if the wires are touching my chest.

            Would love to see a clever solution/fix implemented for that.

            Having the option to change the ear tips would be nice, but this doesn't have that.

            Near impossible for to play games like cod because you can hold your phone fully.

            I'm learning to hold the phone differently while gaming now.

            The sound quality is very good with xiaomi sound

            And immersive sound enabled.

            And with this earphone I also realised Dolby is a scam, they do very basic adjustments, and this earphone can easily point out everywhere Dolby is missing the mark.

            It isn't as convenient as a wireless earpods, but wired ones help you use your phone less, and possibly beark addictions, and is a lost less waste of materials in these, so yeah I like it.

            I think I'll look for a more premium one next time.

            But this doesn't feel cheap either.

          About this Item

          • 🌙 Ultimate Side-Sleeper Comfort: Engineered with an ultra-compact, low-profile design that sits flush in your ear—perfect for side sleepers to enjoy a pain-free, restful night.
          • ☁️ Skin-Friendly Soft Silicone: Crafted from premium, velvet-soft silicone that offers a lightweight, pressure-free fit, making you feel like you aren't wearing earphones at all.
          • 🎵 Balanced 13mm Audio: Powered by 13mm Drivers tuned specifically for sleep, delivering crisp and soothing sound for white noise, relaxing podcasts, or deep-sleep melodies.
          • 🔇 Noise-Reducing Seal: The ergonomic in-ear fit acts as a natural shield, blocking out disruptive ambient sounds like snoring or city traffic for a distraction-free slumber.
          • 🐍 Durable Sleep-Proof Cable: Features a high-quality, tangle-resistant TPE wire that is flexible enough to handle nightly tossing and turning without snapping or tangling.
